name: io.github.Servosity/runzero-mcp
title: runZero MCP
description: Every runZero query, plus a local SQLite copy of your whole attack surface that diffs over time

environmentVariables.name: RUNZERO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the RUNZERO_API_KEY credential for the runZero MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: RUNZERO_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the runZero API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: RUNZERO_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on runZero requests.

environmentVariables.name: RUNZERO_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any non-GET execute call. Leave blank to keep every tool (a tool that changes runZero data still sends only with confirm: true).

environmentVariables.name: RUNZERO_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, the response cache is off, and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: RUNZERO_MCP_UPLOAD_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Leave blank: an MCP upload (the scan, Nessus and packet imports) then takes the file's content base64-encoded. Set it to a directory to let MCP callers name a file inside that directory instead; a path outside it is refused.

environmentVariables.name: RUNZERO_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: binds the MCP server to an existing tenant-gated Printing Press client profile. Leave unset for a single-tenant install.
